site_name: Oman Court, Oman Avenue, London, NW2 6AY
description: Variation of condition 2 (Approved drawings) to allow:Replacement of sedum green roofing with EPDM roofing New short parapet on the party wall junction between the two proposed dwellings.Minor alteration to the size and position of kitchen rooflights Replacement of cladding boards with white render to the South elevation.Alteration to single storey roof pitches to achieve 15 degrees and associated resizing of clerestory glazing beneath. Addition of photovoltaic panels to pitched roofing and single storey roof areas. The addition of condenser units to each dwelling for domestic air conditioning. White upvc framed double glazing windows.of Full planning permission application reference 20/1335 dated 12/12/2025 for Redevelopment of part of rear parking to Oman Court to build 2 x two-bed residential duplexes with gardens, subject to a Deed of Agreement dated 21st November 2024 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.
